name: Discovery Deck
summary:
The Discovery Deck is a space for new users to go into and enjoy a curated experience while practicing basic controls in virtual reality. Users will have the opportunity to practice movement by teleporting to hotspots, grabbing and manipulating objects, and interacting with a virtual world. While inside the Discovery Deck users will also have the opportunity to view video clips with the latest news from Jenson8 as well as trailers of other products and services offered.
